text_block_list.text:
It happened just as I was heading out
for training...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuughhhhh... What a pain.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I am sooooo totally not in the mood...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, I got spotted.
Ugh, that's so awkward~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, uh...
Isn't it about time for training?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like you just keep staring at your phone? Or maybe you start obsessing over split ends?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, like...
I just kinda don't feel motivated~, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll do it, okay?
I'll do the training, but, man...
If I were to give advice to her while her motivation is down...
choice_data_list: Jogging in a different place than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's it? Just one rep?
I'll be done in no time!

I explained that simply taking the first step is what's crucial,
and that motivation only follows once you actually begin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heh~ I see, I see.
Come to think of it, cleaning up the room might be the same way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, since I went through the trouble of running, might as well make the most of it.
I'll run a bit more~.

Seeing her dash off with such lighthearted steps,
it seemed she hadn't truly hated the training after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's this, some sort of change of pace?

I told her that doing something different from usual
would break the routine and serve as good stimulation.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, field trips in elementary school always got me super hyped up...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Officially it counted as studying,
but it felt more like a mini-field trip.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm off then.
Thanks for the advice~☆

Seeing her almost voluntarily run off,
maybe all she needed was a little push.
